details: Codex workers in linked worktrees can have core.hooksPath configured while ROOT/.git is a file, not a directory. bootstrap_data currently checks ROOT/.git/config before git config, so awf bootstrap reports hooks missing before workers can claim work. Acceptance: uv run awf bootstrap; uv run awf health-status --deep --json; uv run awf verify --profile health --json; uv run awf workflow-fixture-test; uv run awf repo-hygiene; plus bootstrap --json in worktrees 86d7 and f5d6.
title: Fix bootstrap hook detection in linked worktrees
